Enumeration
TransferPropertyEnum
Package
M2::AUTOSARTemplates::SystemTemplate::Fibex::FibexCore::CoreCommunication
Note
Transfer Properties of a Signal.
Aggregated by
ISignalToIPduMapping.transferProperty
Literal
Description
pending
If the signal has the TransferProperty pending, then the function Com_SendSignal shall not perform a
transmission of the IPdu associated with the signal.
Tags: atp.EnumerationLiteralIndex=0
triggered
The signal in the assigned IPdu is updated and a request for the IPdu’s transmission is made.
Tags: atp.EnumerationLiteralIndex=1
triggeredOnChange
The signal in the assigned IPdu is updated and a request for the IPdus transmission is made only if
the signal value is different from the already stored signal value.
Tags: atp.EnumerationLiteralIndex=2
triggeredOnChange
WithoutRepetition
The signal in the assigned IPdu is updated and a request for the IPdus transmission is made only if
the signal value is different from the already stored signal value. In the DIRECT/N-TIMES or MIXED
transmission mode (EventControlledTiming) the IPdu will be transmitted just once without a
repetition, independent of the defined NumberOfRepeats.
Tags: atp.EnumerationLiteralIndex=3
triggeredWithout
Repetition
